title: C3

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (s:Sample)-[rex:Sample_hasSampleRegulation]-(g2:GeneExpression) WHERE g2.hasPrimaryName = 'AKT3' AND g2.hasRegulation = 'under'  RETURN s.hasSampleName AS SampleName, g2.hasRegulation AS Regulation, s.hasPrimaryHistology AS CancerType LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (s:Sample)-[:INCLUDEDIN]->(c:Cancer),       (p:Protein)-[:ASSOCIATEDWITH]->(c),       (e:GeneExpression)-[:INVOLVES]->(p) WHERE p.hasFullName = 'AKT3' AND e.hasRegulation = 'under' RETURN s.hasSampleName AS sampleName, e.hasRegulation AS regulation, c.hasPrimaryName AS cancerType;

Actually from schema: from: Sample, to: Protein; so the relationship direction is Sample to Protein. So pattern (s)-[r:SampleHasProtein]->(p). We'll match this. But r has property hasProteinHasRegulationValue. So we need to filter r.hasProteinHasRegulationValue = 'Under' or maybe 'Under expression'. But property may exactly store 'Under expression' maybe. We'll use 'Under' for property. Use 'Under' to satisfy "under expression".  Then we need to match Sample to Cancer. Relationship SampleHasCancer from Sample to Cancer. So MATCH (s)-[:SampleHasCancer]->(c:Cancer). The Cancer node has property hasProteinHasClassification. So we can return s.hasPrimaryName as sampleName, r.hasProteinHasRegulationValue as regulation, c.hasProteinHasClassification as cancerType.  We need to limit to 100.  So final Cypher query:  MATCH (s:Sample)-[r:SampleHasProtein]->(p:Protein) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = 'AKT3' AND r.hasProteinHasRegulationValue = 'Under' MATCH (s)-[:SampleHasCancer]->(c:Cancer) RETURN s.hasPrimaryName AS sampleName, r.hasProteinHasRegulationValue AS regulation, c.hasProteinHasClassification AS cancerType LIMIT 100  But we need to confirm property names: In Sample nodes, property hasPrimaryName exists;

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:LOCATEDIN|HAS_FUNCTIONAL_DOMAIN]->(fd:FunctionalDomain {hasPrimaryName: 'PI3_PI4_kinase'}) MATCH (p)-[:HASMUTATION]->(m:Mutation) MATCH (p)-[:LOCATEDIN]->(pw:Pathway) RETURN pw.hasPrimaryName AS pathwayName, m.hasMutationDescription AS mutationDescription LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (pw:Pathway)-[:hasComponent]->(p:Protein)-[:HASMUTATION]->(m) MATCH (fd:FunctionalDomain)-[:contains]->(p) WHERE fd.hasPrimaryName = 'PI3_PI4_kinase' RETURN pw.hasPrimaryName AS pathwayName, collect(m.hasMutationDescription) AS mutationDescriptions;
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:includesDomain]->(d:FunctionalDomain)-[:hasDomain]->(f:Domain) WHERE d.hasPrimaryName = 'PI3_PI4_kinase' MATCH (p)-[:belongsToPathway]->(pw:Pathway) MATCH (pw)-[:hasPathwayStatus]->(ps:PathwayStatus) WHERE ps.status = 'included' MATCH (p)-[m]->(mut:Mutation) RETURN pw.hasPrimaryName AS pathwayName, mut.description AS mutationDescription LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:hasFunctionalDomain]->(fd:FunctionalDomain {hasPrimaryName:'PI3_PI4_kinase'}) MATCH (p)-[:hasMutation]->(m) MATCH (p)-[:part_of]->(pw:Pathway) RETURN pw.hasPrimaryName AS pathwayName, m.hasMutationDescription AS mutationDescription LIMIT 100
